import random

def generate_test_case():
    nums_length = random.randint(0, 10)
    
    nums = []
    exlusive = []
    
    a = random.randint(-100000, 100000)
    target = random.randint(-100000, 100000)
    b = target - a
    nums = [a,b]
    exlusive = [a,b]

    for _ in range(nums_length):
        c = random.randint(-100000, 100000)
        if c not in exlusive:
            nums += [c]
            exlusive += [c]
            exlusive += [target-c]
        
    return nums, target
